messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 paging — elevated 5xx rate on streaming-gateway (us-west-2). Current 5m error rate 14% (alert threshold 5%). On-call: @alice. Paging link: https://pager.example/INC-3591

alice: ack — I'm on it. Starting with gateway logs and recent deploys.

chris-sre: I'm here. Seen spikes like this before when NLB idle/timeouts cause connection resets and truncated chunked frames.

alice: quick grep (10m window) shows a lot of 502/504 and "chunked frame truncated" in proxy logs.
```
2026-03-15T14:02:03Z ERROR proxy upstream 10.0.12.33: upstream reset while streaming - chunked frame truncated
2026-03-15T14:02:04Z WARN  connection closed by client: id=0x7f3a
2026-03-15T14:02:05Z ERROR gateway  upstream timeout after 30s
```

alice: running full command: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/stream-gateway -c proxy --since=10m | grep -E "ERROR|WARN" | tail -n 100` — pulling more context.

bhaskar-eng: If it's NLB resets, we can temporarily route high-RPS customers to paged endpoints (non-streaming) to reduce long-lived connections. I can flip routing for a /few/ customers.

dana-pm: Customer impact: Support triage shows tickets from AcmeCorp and NovaAI with streaming sessions dropping mid-generation. Estimated impacted sessions ~12% of their streaming sessions last 30m. Tickets: SUP-1229, SUP-1231.

eve-support: Status page: Drafting an update to mention degraded streaming in us-west-2, non-streamed APIs unaffected. Will post when we have mitigation.

alice: Mitigation plan (immediate):
  1) Scale stream-gateway replicas from 4 -> 12 to absorb spikes.
  2) Route top 5 highest-RPS customers to paged fallback for next 30m.
  3) Increase upstream timeout to 90s temporarily.
  4) Apply NLB TCP keepalive tweak (idle timeout 60s -> 30s).

chris-sre: I'll implement scaling now.
`kubectl scale deploy/stream-gateway --replicas=12 -n prod`

chris-sre: scaling done. New pod count 12. Observability: CPU steady but error rate still elevated.

alice: After scaling + routing change for AcmeCorp/NovaAI, 5xx rate dropped from 14% -> 6% in 10m window. Good progress but still above threshold.

bhaskar-eng: Investigated client patterns — a lot of client cancellations (client-side Ctrl-C / network flaps) leading to upstream receiving truncated chunk frames. That combined with NLB resetting idle connections is causing gateway to return 502s.

alice: I can reproduce locally with a curl test that cancels mid-stream: `curl -N http://gateway/stream?prompt=test` then cancel after first chunk -> gateway logs show truncated frame.

bhaskar-eng: Quick mitigation we applied: route new streaming sessions for non-low-latency customers to paged-mode; keep low-latency customers on streaming. That reduced the number of long-lived connections.

dana-pm: Any data loss? Are tokens lost permanently for customers mid-stream?

alice: Some sessions ended mid-response. For those, the non-streamed retry path (client can request full completion) returns correct completions — no model state lost, but UX is degraded for streaming.

chris-sre: Proposed longer-term fixes:
  - Add TCP keepalive on NLB and gateway (30s).
  - Harden chunked decoding to tolerate client cancellations gracefully and send proper 499-style metrics.
  - Add connection-level retry for small truncated frames.
  - Add e2e test harness simulating cancellations and NLB resets.

alice: I'm opening an infra PR to adjust NLB idle timeout and gateway keepalive config. PR: https://git.example/repo/infra/pull/789 (apply in stages).

bhaskar-eng: Also created a quick patch to classify truncated-chunk errors as client-cancel vs upstream failure so we can avoid inflating 5xx metrics: https://git.example/repo/gateway/pull/456

incident-bot: Timeline note created and incident issue INC-3591 opened.

eve-support: Status update posted: "Degraded streaming in us-west-2; engineering mitigation in progress. Non-streaming APIs unaffected. Next update in 30 minutes."

alice: Monitoring shows error rate trending down to 3.8% after NLB change rolled to 50% of traffic and paged fallback for top customers. Still watching.

chris-sre: Handoff — I'll take watch for next 4 hours. Summary for next oncall: root cause likely NLB idle/keepalive + client cancellations exposing chunked-decoding fragility in gateway. Mitigations applied: scale, paged fallback, NLB keepalive change, classification patch. Ongoing work: roll NLB change fully, merge gateway patch, add tests, and prepare postmortem.

alice: Thanks. I'll collect logs and partial traces into the incident issue. Will also attach a sampling of truncated requests and affected customer IDs (redacted).

dana-pm: Notify account teams for AcmeCorp and NovaAI to offer remediation steps and offer to replay sessions where possible.

eve-support: Notifying customers and updating tickets. Will send a follow-up once tracking is complete. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Handoff posted to oncall: @chris-sre is now owner for INC-3591. Next update scheduled in 30m unless status changes.

chris-sre: ack — taking over. Creating follow-on tasks and will schedule a postmortem after stabilization.

alice: tagging this thread into incident issue: https://issues.example/INC-3591 — continuing log collection.

chris-sre: closing loop for live mitigation — leaving the channel for lower-noise updates. If error rate creeps above 5% again, re-paging.

alice: thanks all — nice quick coordination.
